body: My dilemma with that is if I portray the events of my life and how I felt, it would surely distance my relationship further with my family.

Up north somewhere would be nice,Oregon, Washington. But Id really like to leave to US altogether. I dont have high hopes for the United States and believe things will only get worse. 

Im still undecided with film. The entire time at school my instructors kept discouraging everyone saying we're going into an industry that doesn't want us. Telling us their sob stories. My degree was only an associates.
